system.description: Your shadow slides into a creature within 20' and hollows it out.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the possession lasts d4 + 2 rounds.
outcomes.success: The creature takes d6 damage and is Charmed by you for d4 rounds; it acts when you command it (◈), as a minion. A Strong or Mighty creature is Stupefied for d4 rounds instead.
outcomes.ruin: Your shadow does not come back: you cast no shadow until your next Downtime, and the dark knows you (Bane on tests to hide). Roll on the Shadowblight table.
